chronology.execution: first observed one-minute open strictly later than decision availability plus latency
chronology.stage_boundary: mark unresolved exposure and retain the global slot; never strategy-close at a research boundary

survival: positive exact top-five-positive-event deletion with full one-slot rerouting

event.anchor: exact completed breakout-hour turnover / volume VWAP
event.break: first completed one-hour close >=0.10 prior-only ATR20 through the pool
event.continuation_state: retest closes on the original break side of the anchor
event.participation: pooled 2021 upper quartile of prior-only 168h log-turnover z-score
event.retest: first same-day completed five-minute bar that touches the frozen anchor
event.reversal_state: retest closes through the anchor against the original break

integrity_note: The logic and rule were fixed before the first local computation in the interactive session, but the durable GitHub Work Claim was created only after a preliminary negative screen. Therefore this result may be retained only as negative evidence and cannot authorize a positive route or official evaluation.

logic.thesis: A high-participation completed-hour break through pre-known prior-day external liquidity freezes the event-hour turnover/volume VWAP as the initiative inventory cost anchor. The first same-day causal five-minute retest decides whether that inventory is defended for continuation or lost for reversal.

payoff.continuation_target: nearest still-unconsumed pre-known D1/H4 liquidity in break direction
payoff.hard_stop: one tick plus 0.10 decision ATR20 beyond full signal/retest excursion
payoff.state_exit: first later completed five-minute close through the anchor against the action, executed causally after latency
